label_definition.name: LSAR
label_definition.description: Long-tail/short-tail actin-activated ATPase kcat ratio for paired two-headed HMM constructs.
label_definition.units: dimensionless ratio of rates in s^-1

spudich_additional_na_percent.note: Compilation display may appear capped at 100 and near-WT negatives at 0; raw LSAR and uncapped transform are preserved separately.

na_rel.note: Force-facing relative available-heads term; owned in detail by later ensemble-force method.

study_normalization_percent.note: Within-study normalization using matched study WT LSAR; must not be conflated with Spudich global transform.

table1_implied_lsar_audit_only.note: Reverse-calculated from rounded Table 1 percent; audit-only; never a training label.

files.measurements.csv: Source-level and biological-replicate evidence rows. Replicates live only here.
files.labels.csv: One canonical row per Table 1 variant.
files.exclusions.csv: Approximate, unresolved, assay-absent, and unresolved-prior-epoch records that are not modeling-ready.
files.SHA256SUMS: SHA-256 digests of the public derivative files in this directory.
files.README.md: Human-readable release notes and licensing limitation.

modeling_eligibility_values.candidate_exact: Exact primary evidence candidate for continuous LSAR after pooling review.
modeling_eligibility_values.review_low_n: Exact primary evidence with low biological replication; retained but not auto modeling-ready.
modeling_eligibility_values.candidate_exact_mismatch_review: Exact primary evidence with magnitude mismatch versus Table 1 display; retained for review.
modeling_eligibility_values.candidate_later_epoch_review: Exact later-epoch evidence that does not recover an earlier unpublished compilation value.
modeling_eligibility_values.exclude_blank: Assay absent; blank is not zero; not modeling-ready.
modeling_eligibility_values.exclude_unresolved_prior_epoch: Earlier unpublished evidence epoch unresolved; separate from a later published epoch.

policies.reported_vs_recomputed: Preserve reported LSAR separately from recomputed long/short.
policies.preprint_final_dedup: Preprint and final versions of the same summary are one evidence identity.
policies.stage_claim: S1 provenance-ready; not S2 (no pinned runnable regeneration pipeline in this release).
